<string name="change_log_md_body">New Features {added marginTop}
======================

* **Introducing text chat…*but in voice channels.*** Voice channels now have embedded chat that's specific to each voice channel. Peep general, is a thing of the past. 
* **But how exactly do they work?** How's this different from regular text channels? They pop out, they're unique to a voice channel, and if you wanna learn more, [I gotchu.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)

Fixes and Updates {progress}
======================

* **Added li'l flags to language selection.** It's not that important…but it's cute. :)
* **Are you sure you want to log out?** alert added for when you log out. And you're sure of it. If you're unsure, flip a coin.
* **In-app notifications now show images.** Nice.
* **Added 6 countries to our billing forms.** If you're from: Ascension (AC), Diego Garcia (DG), East Timor (TP), Kosovo (XK), Midway Island (MI), or Netherland Antilles (AN), you can now properly input your addresses.

You can change your [Find your Friend settings](onFriendSettingsClick) at any time.</string>

issue.errorLine1:
<string name="change_log_md_body">New Features {added marginTop}
======================

* **Introducing text chat…*but in voice channels.*** Voice channels now have embedded chat that's specific to each voice channel. Peep general, is a thing of the past. 
* **But how exactly do they work?** How's this different from regular text channels? They pop out, they're unique to a voice channel, and if you wanna learn more, [I gotchu.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)

Fixes and Updates {progress}
======================

* **Added li'l flags to language selection.** It's not that important…but it's cute. :)
* **Are you sure you want to log out?** alert added for when you log out. And you're sure of it. If you're unsure, flip a coin.
* **In-app notifications now show images.** Nice.
* **Added 6 countries to our billing forms.** If you're from: Ascension (AC), Diego Garcia (DG), East Timor (TP), Kosovo (XK), Midway Island (MI), or Netherland Antilles (AN), you can now properly input your addresses.


</string>

The resource `R.string.change_log_md_body` appears to be unused
issue.errorLine1:
<string name="change_log_md_body">New Features {added marginTop}
======================

* **Introducing text chat…*but in voice channels.*** Voice channels now have embedded chat that's specific to each voice channel. Peep general, is a thing of the past. 
* **But how exactly do they work?** How's this different from regular text channels? They pop out, they're unique to a voice channel, and if you wanna learn more, [I gotchu.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)

Fixes and Updates {progress}
======================

* **Added li'l flags to language selection.** It's not that important…but it's cute. :)
* **Are you sure you want to log out?** alert added for when you log out. And you're sure of it. If you're unsure, flip a coin.
* **In-app notifications now show images.** Nice.
* **Added 6 countries to our billing forms.** If you're from: Ascension (AC), Diego Garcia (DG), East Timor (TP), Kosovo (XK), Midway Island (MI), or Netherland Antilles (AN), you can now properly input your addresses.


</string>

<string name="change_log_md_body">Nuevas características {added marginTop}
======================

* **Presentamos el chat de texto... pero en los canales de voz.*** Cada canal de voz tiene ahora incorporado un chat específico. Lo he pasado al canal general será cosa del pasado. 
* **Pero ¿cómo funcionan exactamente?** ¿Y en qué se diferencian respecto de los canales de texto de siempre? Saldrán en una ventana emergente, son exclusivos para cada canal de voz y, si quieres saber más, [aquí lo tienes todo.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)

Correcciones y actualizaciones {progress}
======================

* **Hemos puesto banderitas en la selección de idioma.** No es algo megaimportante... pero queda muy cuqui. :)
* **Hemos añadido un aviso antes de cerrar sesión** para confirmar que quieres salir. Pues claro que quieres. Y si no lo tienes claro... no sé, lanza una moneda.
* **En las notificaciones de la aplicación se mostrarán imágenes.** Mola.
* **Hemos añadido 6 países a nuestros formularios de facturación.** Si eres de: Ascensión (AC), Diego García (DG), Timor Oriental (TP), Kosovo (XK), Islas Midway (MI), o de las Antillas Neerlandesas (AN), puedes poner tu dirección sin problemas.


</string>

<string name="change_log_md_body">Nya funktioner {added marginTop}
======================

* **Vi presenterar textchatt …*fast i röstkanaler.*** Röstkanalerna har nu en inbäddad chatt som är specifik för varje röstkanal. Att smygtitta tillhör det förgångna. 
* **Men exakt hur fungerar de?** Hur skiljer sig detta från vanliga textkanaler? De poppar ut, de är unika för en röstkanal. Vill du lära dig mer? [Det fixar jag.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)

Fixar och uppdateringar {progress}
======================

* **Vi har lagt till små flaggor till språkvalen.** Inte så där jätteviktigt ... Men det är gulligt. :)
* **En Är du säker på att du vill logga ut?**-varning talar nu om att du håller på att logga ut. Och det kan du vara säker på. Om du inte är säker, kan du singla slant.
* **Aviseringar inuti appen visar nu bilder.** Snyggt.
* **Vi har lagt till sex länder till våra faktureringsformulär.** Om du är från Ascension (AC), Diego Garcia (DG), Östtimor (TP), Kosovo (XK), Midwayöarna (MI) eller Nederländska Antillerna (AN) kan du nu ange din adress på ett korrekt sätt.


</string>
